title: Edit
description:
A user edit, as the UI sends it. [`run`] turns it into the commands of one history step, so the UI holds no
domain logic: trimming under a moved clip, routing checks, lane clamping all happen here.

algorithm.description: Algorithm of a new reverb; the default one if absent.

oneOf.description: Tracks dragged to a new place: before `before` (the end if none), routed to `output` (TRK-1, TRK-3).
The sidechain of a block: the first compressor if `block` is absent; a band of a dynamic EQ (FX-15).
A band of an EQ (the first one if `block` is absent) or of a dynamic EQ.
A change to the structure of a chain (FX-10, FX-11): add, remove, move, duplicate, reset, bands.

A block's settings that are not continuous parameters (modes, character, voices, enabled bands, musical
rate): the whole block, same id and kind. Continuous values go through `SetParam`.

The settings of a return's processor that are not continuous (FX-22 interval, FX-23 mode and character): the
whole processor, same type. Continuous values go through `SetParam`.
Changes the algorithm of a reverb return (FX-5); its parameters stay as they are.
Replaces a lane's points (creates the lane); the lane becomes the user's (AUT-2).
AUT-2 freehand: the stroke replaces the lane over its span, simplified into points (tolerance in value units).
AUT-2 paste: copied points (frames relative to the copy start) placed at `at`, replacing that span.
AUT-2 range delete: removes the points inside `[from, to]`.
AUT-3: shifts a whole curve by `delta` (a control moved while stopped).
The project's name as shown (the package folder keeps its own name).
The whole master state (master phase, its own history: HIS-5).

BassEnhancer.description: Bass enhancer (FX-18): harmonics of the low band, no octave below.

Clipper.description: Peak clipper (MAS-11): takes up to `take_off_db` off the tallest peaks that reach it, wherever it sits.

mix.description:
Dry/wet, 0..1: below 1 the uncompressed signal is blended back in (parallel compression, FX-3). Tracks
and groups only: the master compressor keeps it at 1.

sidechain.description: Detector input from another track or group, post-fader (FX-3).

oneOf.description: Only what is above the frequency goes down.
The whole signal goes down.
The input summed to mono, repeats alternating left and right.

range_db.description: Most gain the band takes, −12 … +6 dB: negative cuts, positive lifts.

sidechain.description: The detector hears the same band of another track or group (FX-3).

bypass.description: TPDF dither is applied only when exporting at 16 bit (MAS-1); this switch can disable it.

Doubler.description: Doubler (FX-21): voices slightly out of tune and slowly moving in time, inside the track.

DynamicEq.description: Dynamic EQ (FX-15): one or two bands that move only when their detector passes the threshold.

bit_depth.description: 16, 24 or 32 (float) for WAV; 16 or 24 for FLAC.

folder.description: Destination folder outside the package; `None` means `masters/` inside it.

Filter.description: High-pass or low-pass (FX-1, FX-12): 12 dB/octave, with a resonance.

resonance.description: Q of the filter, 0.5 … 10; 0.707 is the flat Butterworth response of schema 3 (FX-12).

id.description: `<kind key>` or `<kind key><n>` (`eq`, `eq2`): unique in the chain, stable when the block moves.

FxKind.description: The kinds of blocks, in the order the "Add block" menu lists them by family (UI-12).

FxOp.description: A change to the structure of a chain (FX-10, UI-12): the interface asks, the core does it. Each is one step.

oneOf.description: A new block at a place in the chain (`None`: last).
A copy of the block right after it.
A block back to the values a new one has (it stays on or off as it is).
Number of bands of a multiband (two to six) or of a dynamic EQ (one or two), or voices of a harmonizer.

range_db.description: How far the signal goes down below the threshold.

ratio.description: 1 … 20: at 20 it is a gate, below an expander.

oneOf.description: A square with rounded edges.

MasterBlock.description: A free block of the master chain: it can be moved, switched off and, for some kinds, be there twice.

id.description: Stable within the project ("b1", "b2"…): section offsets, notes and the engine refer to it.

MasterChain.description:
The master chain (MAS-1): the input gain, then the free blocks in the order they process, then limiter and
dither, which always close it (the limiter guarantees the ceiling only if nothing follows it, MAS-3).

MasterComp.description:
The compressor of the master chain: stereo-linked, with a dry/wet mix (parallel compression) and a high-pass on
its detector (MAS-13). It has no sidechain: nothing else plays in the master.

listen_above_hz.description: The detector does not hear what is below this frequency; 0 lets it hear everything.

mix.description: 0..1: share of the compressed signal; under 1 the rest is the untouched input.

reference.description: Reference used by match EQ, A/B and the AI (an id of `references`).

sections.description: Offsets per section (MAS-14); sections without offsets are not listed.

target_kept.description: The author keeps the destination although it is far from the references (design 9t): no warning about it.

gain_db.description: Level of the band after its compressor.

cover.description: Cover image inside the package (`masters/cover.<ext>`), if any.

mix_hash.description: Hash of the mix state the mixdown was rendered from (MDN-4).

sync.description: Musical value ("1/4", "1/8.") that sets the rate from the tempo, if any.

Multiband.description: Multiband compressor (MAS-12): two to six bands split by `crossovers_hz` (ascending, one fewer than the bands).

oneOf.description: FX-5. The return level is the return track's fader.

shimmer_amount.description: FX-22: 0 … 1; at 0 the shimmer is a hall.

shimmer_semitones.description: FX-22 (shimmer only): interval of the pitch shift in the recirculation, +5, +7 or +12 semitones.

drive_db.description: Tape drive in the feedback, 0 … 12 dB, level compensated.

sync.description: Musical value (e.g. "1/8", "1/4.") that sets `time_ms` from the tempo, if any.

ReverbAlgorithm.description: The reverbs of FX-5 (`shimmer`, FX-22: a hall with a pitch shift in its recirculation).

oneOf.description: Acoustic and classical music (A-080): piano on its own, woodwinds, a choir.
The waveshaper of FX-4 (and of every project before P-018).

character.description: FX-18; the master's saturation is always `soft`.

SectionOffsets.description:
Offsets of one section on top of the song-wide master (MAS-14): they act only while the section plays and
glide in and out at its edges.

eq.description: Added to the gains of the bands of an EQ block.

level_db.description: Added to the level that reaches the limiter.

side_gain_db.description: Added to the side gain of the width block.

StereoWidth.description: Stereo width of a track, group or return (FX-19).

TrackClipper.description: Clipper of a track (FX-17): an absolute threshold.

speed.description: 0 … 1: how short the attack part is.

phase_deg.description: Phase offset of the right channel in tremolo mode, degrees.

mono_below_hz.description: Below this frequency the signal is folded to mono; 0 disables it.
